description: This file defines the 'BusinessEvent' interface used across the Fineract infrastructure event handling system, specifying methods for event data retrieval and categorization.

classes.name: BusinessEvent
classes.description: Interface representing a business event with methods to access event data, type, category, and associated aggregate root ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the event data of generic type T.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the event.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the event.

methods.name: getAggregateRootId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the aggregate root associated with the event.
